title: Fintech: payments, data and operational risks
excerpt: Fintech in Moldova: payment roles, data, errors and continuity. Prepare risk records without assuming authorisation or insurance cover.

seo.title: Fintech operational risks in Moldova | ING Broker
seo.description: Prepare payment-service roles, data flows, partners, errors and continuity for risk discussion. This article confirms neither authorisation nor a fintech policy.
seo.keywords: fintech insurance Moldova, payment operational risk, processing errors, financial service continuity, customer data

content:
For a fintech company, bank or technology provider in the Republic of Moldova, risk is not limited to a failed server. The company's service role, the data it processes, partner relationships and the consequences of an error for customers all matter. Before discussing insurance, describe the actual work and the responsibilities belonging to the company rather than relying on a general technology label.

This article provides a way to organize risk information. It confirms neither authorization for an activity nor availability of a fintech policy or an insurer's acceptance of a service. BNM's payment-systems page supplies official context about institutions, mechanisms and instruments. The legal status of each operator needs separate verification. An insurance conversation is not a substitute for that verification.

Describe the service without overly general terms

A financial platform might be an interface application, software provision, technical processing or a service involving other responsibilities. Explain who the customer is, what action they can perform and the company's exact role. Using financial technology does not automatically make a business a bank or an authorized payment provider. The description should identify actual functions, not suggest a legal status that has not been established.

For the team preparing the file, a role-based overview can distinguish customer, company, contractual partner and technical provider. Exclude passwords, codes, integration keys and internal addresses. The purpose is to understand the commercial relationships and service, not disclose security architecture or operational access. Agree separately on any detailed information genuinely required by a competent recipient.

Separate money flows from data flows

An application can display payment information without the same entity administering every transfer stage. Record the information received, who executes the operation under the contracts and which confirmations reach the customer. Describe functions without real account details or customer transactions. This allows the service relationship to be explained without exposing individual financial information merely to obtain an initial insurance explanation.

Distinguish a delayed display, a recording error and a problem concerning funds. They are not synonyms. A screenshot or automated message alone establishes neither cause, liability nor loss. Documents and specialist explanations should make each relevant stage traceable. Keep an unresolved discrepancy identified as unresolved instead of turning a customer-facing message into a definitive financial conclusion.

Identify responsibility for each component

Partner contracts may address development, hosting, maintenance, support or another function. Prepare an inventory of roles and the documents supporting them. Using a provider's infrastructure does not automatically transfer every consequence to that provider. The meaning of obligations requires examination of actual agreements, not an inference from a cloud service's commercial name or from which team usually receives support calls.

Separate the entity contracting with the customer from the application developer and any group companies. A platform's brand does not replace a legal name for insurance assessment. Describe different services and markets distinctly. Do not assume one contract or limit applies to the entire group simply because its companies share an interface, reception desk or commercial presentation.

A professional error is not every cyber incident

A wrong calculation, an implementation that differs from an accepted specification and unauthorized access are different scenarios. Describe the observed effect and available information without immediately assigning a cause. Technology professional liability and cyber risk need distinctions in the actual documents. A generic promise of digital protection does not establish an identical answer for these separate situations.

If several causes remain possible, keep the questions open for specialist assessment. Identify the active service version and available acceptance or testing records. Do not publish complete logs or vulnerability information. The initial file can identify evidence categories without exposing sensitive content. A record of a test also needs its scope understood before anyone calls it proof of implementation quality or security.

Service availability also has economic consequences

Even a short interruption can leave additional work after the system restarts. Identify accumulated checks, support, reconciliation or rescheduling for planning purposes. Estimates should come from responsible teams and be labelled as estimates. The number of affected users is not automatically an amount payable to each user. Explain what the count represents before using it in an economic summary.

Keep postponed revenue separate from lost revenue and additional expenses separate from ordinary costs. Explain a financial loss rather than only writing a total. For insurance terms, examine the required event, relevant period and calculation basis. Not every service interruption is automatically a contractual event. An operational recovery and an insurer's acceptance of expenses are different outcomes.

Keep change documents organized

A new function, partner integration or processing change can alter the activity description. Retain the change date, internal approvals and available test records. A completed checklist shows what was documented, not that the implementation is necessarily correct. Technical assessment serves a separate purpose. Make the relevant version identifiable so an explanation about the old configuration is not silently reused for the new one.

A commercial file may need only a summary of change management and responsibilities initially. Source code, keys, configurations and customer information should not go through an open enquiry. Before any detailed transmission, clarify need, recipient and channel. Distinguishing the summary from restricted evidence helps provide useful information without circulating material unrelated to the actual question.

Do not confuse fraud, error and disputes

A balance difference or contested payment may need reconciliation and investigation. Do not automatically label it fraud or blame an employee or customer before findings. Retain the chronology and documents while competent people determine appropriate checks. This article gives no technical or financial investigation procedure. It does not establish wrongdoing from a complaint, a system message or an initial accounting observation.

For insurance questions, say whether the matter concerns a customer demand, the company's own loss or response expenditure. These can be connected without having identical contractual treatment. The term fintech does not settle their classification. Actual conditions and documented facts must be examined together rather than assuming all consequences belong to one insurable category.

Prepare a risk sheet useful to management

The sheet can identify services, customer categories, relevant countries, partners and available document types. Include known incidents and open issues without personal detail. Keep live operations separate from internal tests, announced functions not yet activated and withdrawn services. A management summary should describe the current business, not combine every historic or planned feature into an apparently operational platform.

For financial figures, identify source and period: service revenue, operating expenses and other bases requested by the competent reviewer. Total payment volume is not automatically a potential loss or insured sum. These figures describe different things. Ask which basis is needed, provide relevant support and explain the distinction before comparing values from separate proposals.

What to check in proposed insurance documentation

Ask for the entities, declared services and people concerned to be identified. Read the limit, excess, territory, period and exclusions. The excess is the insured's share of a loss under the contract. Exclusions describe situations outside its protection. Where relevant, ask about demands, defence costs and notification. Inclusion is not established merely because a question appears in this checklist.

Distinguish professional liability, own loss, cyber incidents and people-related risks. A presentation cannot replace conditions. BNM explains general insurance-contract elements, but the eligibility of a fintech service and treatment of particular funds or data require confirmation for the actual situation. Neither an official general explanation nor this informational article promises payment or establishes acceptance of an individual activity.

Example: inconsistent confirmations after a service change

Imagine a platform finding that some confirmations displayed to customers differ from partner records. The team prepares a chronology and separates operations needing checking from those already reconciled. It publishes no transactions and does not presume funds have been lost. This is hypothetical and concerns no real company or customer. Its purpose is to explain document organization rather than the cause of a particular discrepancy.

The administrative file retains the service version, evidence categories and relevant communications. Specialists examine cause and obligations. Any insurance discussion then uses verified facts. This organization does not prove coverage. It prevents a display error from being confused with an unsupported financial or legal finding and shows the issues still requiring an answer.

Use this preparation before a discussion

Prepare a page describing the actual service and three priorities: the loss being considered, the relevant entity and available documents. That is more useful than an enquiry labelled only banking insurance. Authorization, payment obligations and contract interpretation need competent specialists. The summary directs questions to those roles without determining the answer itself.

Insurance ING Broker SRL is an insurance broker, not the financial-service provider, authorization authority or guarantor of operations. This article states no availability of a special fintech policy. Any later commercial assessment must separately confirm the product, activity eligibility and conditions. Technology use alone should never be presented as evidence of insurance protection.

Connect support and reconciliation without merging them

A customer may contact support while another team checks the operation. Link the request, issue category and confirmed reply without personal information in the commercial summary. A support message is not a financial finding while checks remain unfinished. Keep the link traceable without copying private conversations or individual transaction data into a general insurance enquiry.

For management, distinguish closed matters, cases under review and formal demands. Ticket counts do not necessarily equal unique customers or a loss amount. One person can send several messages about the same issue. Explain that count rather than using repeated messages as an impact multiplier. An already reconciled operation should also not remain unresolved merely because older tickets still refer to it.

Update supplier dependencies over time

Moving a function to another provider may change relevant agreements while the customer interface stays unchanged. Retain contract version and service description without access details or configurations. Check whether the risk summary still matches current operations and whether any described functions have been withdrawn. An unchanged screen is not proof of an unchanged contractual relationship behind it.

Use the same description when comparing insurance replies, or identify revisions openly. Otherwise differences may reflect different information rather than better terms. Accurate roles, periods and versions support an assessment without certifying authorization, security or activity eligibility. Preserve unanswered points rather than filling them with an assumption borrowed from another product or company.

Frequently asked questions about fintech and insurance

Does a cyber policy automatically cover a contested payment?

No. Describe the facts and check applicable documents. A dispute, processing error and cyber incident can require different assessments. A policy name alone establishes no individual response.

Is transaction volume the insured sum?

Do not assume equivalence. Volume, revenue and scenario exposure are different information. The competent reviewer should explain the required basis and the relevant supporting data.

What can be sent initially?

The service description, roles, customer categories and available documents. Do not send passwords, keys, card details, individual transactions or system access. Necessary detail follows later through an agreed channel.

Does this article confirm a company's authorization?

No. Entity status and activity requirements need separate competent sources and documents. Risk assessment or an insurance discussion does not replace that verification.

The broker explains options and arranges insurance where possible; the insurer decides acceptance and claims under the contract.
